# QS-PROC-07 Quench and temper process window (P2) Rev B

Scope
This quality specification defines the process window and controls for quench and temper operations on parts produced at Plant P2, line P2-L2 using equipment EQ-P2-L2-IH01. It specifies required inputs, monitoring points, and references for operators and quality engineers.

Requirements table
| Element | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Plant / Line | P2 / P2-L2 |
| Equipment | EQ-P2-L2-IH01 |
| Lubricant part number for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 | CFW-LUB-938 |
| Controlled parameters | As defined in SOP-P2-L2-02 and SOP-P2-L2-04 |
| Process window acceptance | See SB-1024 for sampling and statistical criteria |
| Record location | Production batch record and electronic process log per SOP-P2-L2-02 |

Inspection method
Inspection consists of review of the production batch record and the electronic process log for the run. Verify presence of lubricant documentation and confirmation that CFW-LUB-938 was installed on EQ-P2-L2-IH01 prior to operation. Cross-check run parameter adherence against SOP-P2-L2-02 and SOP-P2-L2-04. For any parameter deviations flagged in the electronic process log, review SB-1024 for required sampling, disposition, and reporting actions.

Nonconformance handling
For any nonconformance discovered during inspection, follow the containment, investigation, and disposition workflow described in SB-1024. Document the nonconformance in the batch record and initiate corrective action per SOP-P2-L2-04. If lubricant mismatch or absence on EQ-P2-L2-IH01 is confirmed, tag affected material and suspend related production activities until corrective measures are implemented and verified per SOP-P2-L2-02. Final disposition must be recorded and approved by authorized quality personnel.

Related documents: SB-1024, SOP-P2-L2-02, SOP-P2-L2-04
